name: Salsa
instructions: Pour boiled water from kettle in pot, 4 inches deep and immerse the tomatoes for 1 minute
Dip in cold water and drain in colander
Coarsely chop tomatoes and place in colander to let drain in sink for 20-30 minutes
Finely chop the jalapeno, onions, peppers, carrots, garlic
Mix together the chopped tomatoes, jalapeno peppers, and onions and boil them for 45 minutes
After the boiling is done, mix in the rest of the ingredients
